 Football
 Soccer-Barcelona bounce back with big win over Alaves
 Sunday, 01 Nov 2026
 | 6:08 AM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Soccer Football - LaLiga - FC Barcelona v Deportivo Alaves - Spotify Camp Nou, Barcelona, Spain - October 31, 2026 FC Barcelona's Lamine Yamal celebrates scoring their fourth goal with Raphinha REUTERS/Albert Gea 
 Oct 31 (Reuters) - ⁠Barcelona responded after losses to ⁠Real Madrid and Paris St ‌Germain with an emphatic 6-1 win overAlaves at Camp Nou on Saturday night, as ​Raphinha,Fermin Lopez, Lamine Yamal ⁠and Anthony ⁠Gordon got on the scoresheet.
 Raphinha finished Fermin's ⁠cross ‌forBarcelona's first after eight minutes and Lamine was ⁠the provider for Fermin's goal.
 Fermin assisted ​Raphinha ‌again before Lamine added the ⁠fourth in ​first-half stoppage time.
 Substitute Gabriel Jesus set up Lamine's second in the ⁠64th minute and Gordon ​completed the rout.
 Alaves claimed a late consolation through Mariano Diaz, who capitalised ⁠on a mistake by Rodri Hernandez.
 Barcelona top the LaLiga standings on 30 points, two ahead of ​Atletico Madrid, who beat ⁠Levante 2-0 earlier on Saturday. ​Alaves lie eighth after ‌their seventh game without ​a win.
 (Reporting by Ruairidh Barlow, editing by Ed Osmond)
